verdict.rationale: Autumn lets you export your pricing catalog as code: `atmn pull` writes features and plans from Autumn into a local `autumn.config.ts`. It is also described as open-source and can be run locally with `bun dev`, which lowers lock-in. Customer, usage and billing data can only be reached by calling the public API piecemeal (e.g. `atmn api`); there is no documented bulk export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export of customers, balances, usage and logs; open file formats such as CSV or JSON dumps; an offboarding or migration-out guide; independent corroboration of leaving the platform.
